commands:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main
git reset --hard origin/main
git cherry-pick 9d4b995
cd projects/kobra2-neo
uv sync --frozen >/dev/null
uv run pytest -q
git diff --check
echo RESULT:LOCAL_TUNING_READY
set -euo pipefail
cd projects/kobra2-neo
uv run python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import base64, gzip, hashlib, json, tempfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import kobra_plot as kp

root = Path("samples/source")
parts = [root / f"botanical-engraving-plotter-v2.svg.gz.b64.part{i:02d}" for i in range(3)]
payload = "".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() for p in parts)
raw = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(payload, validate=True))
expected = "4fcc330cb7777ed5e2faa5cadd5fbd70674e1bb39f802b6f2794e8565ecb3988"
actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
if actual != expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"source SHA mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual}")

desktop = Path.home() / "Desktop"
src = desktop / "botanical-engraving-150.svg"
gp = desktop / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra.gcode"
pp = desktop / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra-preview.svg"
rp = desktop / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra-report.json"
src.write_bytes(raw)

profile = kp.load_profile()
page = 150.0
ox, oy = 38.0, 58.0

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="botanical-") as td:
    norm = Path(td) / "normalized.svg"
    kp.normalize_svg(src, norm)
    lines = kp.load_normalized_svg(norm)
    root_el = ET.parse(norm).getroot()
    vx, vy, vw, vh = [float(x) for x in root_el.attrib["viewBox"].replace(",", " ").split()]
    mapped = []
    for line in lines:
        out = []
        for x, y in line:
            px = (x - vx) / vw * page
            py = (y - vy) / vh * page
            if profile.orientation.swap_xy:
                px, py = py, px
            if profile.orientation.flip_x:
                px = page - px
            if profile.orientation.flip_y:
                py = page - py
            out.append((ox + px, oy + py))
        mapped.append(out)

    before = len(mapped)
    mapped = kp.merge_touching_polylines(mapped, 0.02)
    b = kp.bounds(mapped)
    ws = profile.workspace
    if not (
        ws.draw_min_x <= b.min_x <= b.max_x <= ws.draw_max_x
        and ws.draw_min_y <= b.min_y <= b.max_y <= ws.draw_max_y
    ):
        raise SystemExit(f"unsafe bounds: {b}")

    gcode = kp.generate_gcode(mapped, profile)
    safety = kp.validate_gcode(gcode, profile)
    stats = kp.geometry_stats(mapped, profile)
    stats["output_bounds"] = b.as_dict()
    stats["polylines_before_touch_merge"] = before
    stats["polylines_after_touch_merge"] = len(mapped)

    gp.write_text(gcode, encoding="utf-8")
    pp.write_text(kp.render_preview(mapped, profile), encoding="utf-8")
    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "title": "Botanical engraving 150x150",
        "bounds_mm": {
            "min_x": round(b.min_x, 2),
            "max_x": round(b.max_x, 2),
            "min_y": round(b.min_y, 2),
            "max_y": round(b.max_y, 2)
        },
        "source": {
            "filename": src.name,
            "sha256": actual,
            "page_mm": [page, page],
            "machine_page_origin_mm": [ox, oy]
        },
        "geometry": stats,
        "profile": {
            "pen_up_z": profile.tool.pen_up_z,
            "pen_down_z": profile.tool.pen_down_z,
            "travel_feed": profile.motion.travel_feed,
            "draw_feed": profile.motion.draw_feed,
            "z_feed": profile.motion.z_feed
        },
        "safety": safety
    }
    report["gcode_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(gcode.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    rp.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print("RESULT:BOTANICAL_V2_PREPARED")
    print("SVG_SHA256", actual)
    print("GCODE_SHA256", report["gcode_sha256"])
    print("GCODE", gp)
    print("PREVIEW", pp)
    print("REPORT", rp)
    print("GEOMETRY", json.dumps(stats, sort_keys=True))
PY
